meta.travel_rule: The requested one-hour limit is a one-way hotel-to-activity public-transit limit. No hotel/venue-specific RTC or Monorail itineraries were verified, so no activity is marked as meeting the limit. A public transit mode is not the same as a verified travel time.
meta.cost_rule: Published prices below are current official prices as of the source snapshot, not guaranteed February–March 2027 prices. Totals for two are simple multiplication of a stated adult ticket/fare; taxes, ticketing fees or future changes are noted.
meta.social_rule: Only direct social URLs linked from an official operator source are shown. Blank means not verified; do not replace with platform search results or guessed handles.

activities.name: Red Rock Canyon National Conservation Area
activities.location: 17 miles west of the Las Vegas Strip (BLM)
activities.days_open: Scenic Drive daily (hours vary by month).
activities.hours: November–February 6:00 AM–5:00 PM; March 6:00 AM–7:00 PM. Timed-entry reservations required Oct 1–May 31 for entry 8:00 AM–5:00 PM.
activities.exceptions: BLM says public transportation does not extend to Red Rock Canyon. Commercial tour buses require reservations and have separate restrictions/charges.
activities.transit_within_60min: No — BLM states public transportation does not extend to the area.
activities.transit_note: Not eligible under the requested bus/rail-only criterion unless a separately verified tour is accepted.
activities.verified_fields: Official BLM page confirms distance from Strip, no public transportation, hours and timed-entry rule.
activities.flag: Exact hotel-origin time and current entry price for two not verified; this activity does not meet the stated transit-only filter.
